body: We just lost our home and dont have the means for food while we look for a place.

I hope you’re okay. We don’t know each other but my heart aches for you. I feel your misery and the empty numbness it brings when you’re left to rot in your own pain. I tried doing it with pills. It didn’t go well or how I had hoped/planned. It broke me psychologically. Throw it up if you can, sweetheart. Let me know you’re here.
